integrity.statement: A global analytic upper-concave-envelope proof is provided, with independent reproducibility calculations supplied as corroboration rather than an infinite proof. The novelty assessment is comparison with inspected accessible sources, not an independent publication-priority certification.

scientific_limitations: Only an ideal projectively monitored two-state transition with i.i.d. nonnegative probing intervals; strictly positive probing intervals change attainment of the short-mean optimum, not its infimum. The analysis excludes adaptive schedules, measurement overhead, noisy detection and multi-dimensional post-failure states.
title: Sharp fixed-mean renewal probing frontier for a two-state quantum detector
